description: The blue obelisk on Bonaire is one stone needle painted blue, set on the south-coast shore by the salt pier to mark the old Blauwe Pan anchorage. The other three colours stand at other pans and are not in this frame. It is mainly clear, about 28.3°C, with wind near 23.3 km/h and cloud cover about 21%. Night water is dark, not turquoise. No company name is shown. The salt pyramids and the white slave huts are other scenes.
